cohortProvenance: Caller-declared database cohort; not independently certified. Candidate metrics must not be pooled with production.
measurementBoundary: Snapshot metadata only; no byte verification, recomputation, standards assessment or signature validation.

importToFirstBoundDraftSeconds.definition: Earliest bound network import to first qualifying draft in retained project history, selecting first drafts in period; includes waiting and user interaction. Deleted history cannot be detected.

approvedTraceableProductionProjects.reason: Current records lack verifiable human approval and digital signatures; draft counts are separate.

productionRepresentativeness.reason: The cohort label is a caller declaration; collection provenance and population coverage are not recorded.

firstAttemptImportSuccessRate.reason: Persisted networks omit rejected attempts and do not identify first attempts; denominator is unavailable.

mediumLeveling30MinuteTarget.reason: Medium-network size and representative production cohort have not been defined or collected.

numericalReproducibilityRate.reason: Requires explicit strict replay outcomes for every selected run; stored bindings are not replay.

strictReverificationCoverage.reason: Current strict validity requires re-reading output/source bytes and live replay. Recorded point-in-time checks are reported separately.

recordedStrictReverificationCoverage.definition: Distinct draft manifests created in period whose latest recorded terminal check before period end passed with unchanged metadata bindings; subsequent failure supersedes a previous pass.
recordedStrictReverificationCoverage.boundary: Historical checks only; metadata bindings match this database snapshot. Output/source bytes are not re-read, and this is not current validity, human approval or population completeness.

recordedVerificationAttemptSuccessRate.definition: Recorded terminal attempts completed in period that passed and still match snapshot metadata / all recorded terminal attempts in period, including failures and lookup errors. Crashes or failed audit writes have no event and are not counted.
recordedVerificationAttemptSuccessRate.boundary: Historical checks only; metadata bindings match this database snapshot. Output/source bytes are not re-read, and this is not current validity, human approval or population completeness.

standardsTraceabilityRate.reason: Free-text citations do not prove authoritative version/clause verification.

unverifiedNumbersInDeliverables.reason: Requires complete artifact value provenance checks, not record counts.

licenseViolations.reason: Requires an independent license audit for the measured scope.

englishChineseResidue.reason: Requires English-rendered state coverage and raw-evidence exclusions.

oneClickEvidenceQuestionCoverage.reason: Requires an inventory of eligible result surfaces and verified question actions; database counts do not measure UI coverage.

dataQualityScope: Manifest timestamps across snapshot; binding and input-time checks for draft history before period end.
snapshotConsistency: Independent read transactions; cross-database bindings checked. Use stopped-app copies for a common snapshot.
